decisions.reason: The source changes the orientation of bottom connectors on the main board; it does not change sensor-board connector placement, alignment, or orientation.
The source concerns main-board connectors and does not alter the power board's mechanical layout or connector-access policy.
Although the battery connector is L-shaped, it is on the power board; the source decision is specifically about bottom connectors on the main board.
Connector orientation does not change the ESP32 module, pin breakout, hole placement, or breakout pitch requirements.
The source changes physical connector orientation, not the interboard connector types, pinouts, pin order, or power and signal topology.
The sensor-module connector inventory and electrical interfaces remain valid unchanged; the source addresses main-board mechanical orientation.
The source does not identify the panel power-button connector or establish that it is one of the affected bottom connectors.
Changing connector orientation has no necessary effect on rail-monitoring IC selection, measured rails, channel allocation, or measurement coverage.
The mechanical orientation change does not alter I2C pull-ups, series resistors, cable length, bus speed, or signal conditioning.
The source does not identify the reset connector and does not change BOOT or reset circuit behavior or capacitance.
The main-board connector orientation decision does not change the USB-C programming interface requirement.
Connector orientation has no necessary effect on DCDC1 output voltage, Schottky-drop compensation, or the target rail voltage.
